### Analytic fits for partial photoionization cross sections. D. A. Verner & D. G. Yakovlev, 1995, A&AS, 109, 125

Abstract. We present a compact, uniform and complete set of analytic fits to the partial Hartree-Dirac-Slater photoionization cross sections for the ground state shells of all atoms and ions of elements from H to Zn (Z <= 30). Comparison with experiment and theory demonstrates generally high accuracy of the fits up to energies of 100 keV. LaTeX 19.8 K, PostScript 91.4 K (text only). 

- Table 1. Fit parameters for partial photoionization cross sections. Description (1.1 K), ASCII (128.9 K), PostScript (236.1 K).
